mapper.update: UPDATE gold_executors e SET completed_tasks = m.done_tasks, total_tasks = m.total_t, task_time_ms = m.total_duration, gc_time_ms = m.total_gc, input_bytes = m.total_input, shuffle_read_bytes = m.total_shuffle_read, shuffle_write_bytes = m.total_shuffle_write, peak_execution_on_heap = m.peak_mem FROM ( SELECT app_id, executor_id, count(*) as total_t, sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' or status = 'SUCCEEDED' then 1 else 0 end) as done_tasks, sum(duration) as total_duration, sum(gc_time) as total_gc, sum(input_bytes) as total_input, sum(shuffle_read_bytes) as total_shuffle_read, sum(shuffle_write_bytes) as total_shuffle_write, max(peak_execution_memory) as peak_mem FROM gold_tasks WHERE app_id = #{appId} GROUP BY app_id, executor_id ) m WHERE e.app_id = m.app_id AND e.executor_id = m.executor_id
mapper.select: SELECT floor(launch_time / 60000) * 60000 as time_window, executor_id, count(*) as task_count, sum(input_bytes) as hdfs_in, sum(output_bytes) as hdfs_out, sum(input_bytes + output_bytes) as hdfs_io, sum(shuffle_read_bytes) as shuffle_read, sum(shuffle_write_bytes) as shuffle_write FROM gold_tasks WHERE app_id = #{appId} GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT floor(launch_time / 60000) * 60000 as time_window, executor_id,
count(*) as value
sum(input_bytes) as value
sum(output_bytes) as value
sum(input_bytes + output_bytes) as value
sum(shuffle_read_bytes) as value
sum(shuffle_write_bytes) as value
0 as value
FROM gold_tasks WHERE app_id = #{appId} GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 ASC

WITH app_info AS ( SELECT app_id, end_time FROM gold_applications WHERE app_id = #{appId} ), exec_durations AS ( SELECT e.executor_id, e.completed_tasks, e.input_bytes, -- Total HDFS I/O (Input + Output) (SELECT sum(input_bytes + output_bytes) FROM gold_tasks gt WHERE gt.app_id = e.app_id AND gt.executor_id = e.executor_id) as total_hdfs_io, e.shuffle_read_bytes, e.shuffle_write_bytes, -- Duration in milliseconds (Explicitly cast to BIGINT to avoid INTERVAL issues) CAST(COALESCE(e.remove_time, a.end_time) - e.add_time AS BIGINT) as duration_ms FROM gold_executors e JOIN app_info a ON e.app_id = a.app_id WHERE e.app_id = #{appId} ) SELECT executor_id, completed_tasks, total_hdfs_io as input_bytes, shuffle_read_bytes, shuffle_write_bytes, duration_ms, CASE WHEN duration_ms > 0 THEN (completed_tasks * 1.0 / (duration_ms / 1000.0)) ELSE 0 END as task_throughput, CASE WHEN duration_ms > 0 THEN (total_hdfs_io * 1.0 / (duration_ms / 1000.0)) ELSE 0 END as hdfs_io_rate, CASE WHEN duration_ms > 0 THEN ((shuffle_read_bytes + shuffle_write_bytes) * 1.0 / (duration_ms / 1000.0)) ELSE 0 END as shuffle_io_rate FROM exec_durations
